/* @arkzen:endpoint:cs:transfers

var rows = await ScriptDatabase.QueryAsync(
    Database,
    """
    SELECT t.id, t.from_account_id, t.to_account_id,
           a.owner AS from_owner, b.owner AS to_owner,
           t.amount, t.status, t.memo, t.created_at
    FROM "aspnet_ledger_transfers" t
    JOIN "aspnet_ledger_accounts" a ON a.id = t.from_account_id
    JOIN "aspnet_ledger_accounts" b ON b.id = t.to_account_id
    ORDER BY t.id DESC
    LIMIT 20
    """,
    null,
    Context.RequestAborted);
return Results.Json(rows);

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react'
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  ActivityIndicator,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native'
import { useAuthStore, setActiveTatemono, arkzenFetch } from '@/arkzen/core/stores/authStore'
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage'

setActiveTatemono('broadcast-test')

const BACKEND_URL   = process.env.ARKZEN_BACKEND_URL   ?? 'http://localhost:8000'
const REVERB_HOST   = process.env.REVERB_HOST          ?? 'localhost'
const REVERB_PORT   = process.env.REVERB_PORT          ?? '8080'
const REVERB_SCHEME = process.env.REVERB_SCHEME        ?? 'ws'
const APP_KEY       = process.env.REVERB_APP_KEY       ?? 'arkzen-key'
/* @arkzen:import:rn:end */

type WsStatus = 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'error'

interface NativeMessage {
  id:           number
  content:      string
  channel_type: string | null
  created_at:   string
}

const StatusDot = ({ status }: { status: WsStatus }) => {
  const color = status === 'connected' ? '#4ade80' : status === 'connecting' ? '#facc15' : '#f87171'
  return <View style={{ width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: color }} />
}

const ChannelCard = ({
  title, badge, badgeColor, description, status, count, msgs, onSend, footer,
}: {
  title:       string
  badge:       string
  badgeColor:  string
  description: string
  status:      WsStatus
  count:       number
  msgs:        NativeMessage[]
  onSend:      (val: string) => void
  footer?:     React.ReactNode
}) => {
  const [input, setInput] = useState('')

  const handleSend = () => {
    const val = input.trim()
    if (!val) return
    onSend(val)
    setInput('')
  }

  return (
    <View className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-neutral-100 overflow-hidden mb-4">
      <View className="px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-neutral-100">
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
            <View className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${badgeColor}`}>
              <Text className="text-white text-xs font-semibold">{badge}</Text>
            </View>
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-800">{title}</Text>
          </View>
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
            <StatusDot status={status} />
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-400">{status}</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-300"> · </Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-400">{count} rx</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mt-1" numberOfLines={2}>{description}</Text>
      </View>

      <View className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-neutral-50 flex-row gap-2 items-center">
        <TextInput
          className="flex-1 bg-neutral-50 border border-neutral-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-neutral-900"
          placeholder="Type and send…"
          placeholderTextColor="#a3a3a3"
          value={input}
          onChangeText={setInput}
          onSubmitEditing={handleSend}
          returnKeyType="send"
          autoCorrect={false}
          autoCapitalize="none"
        />
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSend} activeOpacity={0.8} className="bg-neutral-900 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl">
          <Text className="text-white text-xs font-semibold">Send</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {footer && <View className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-neutral-50">{footer}</View>}

      {msgs.length === 0 ? (
        <View className="py-8 items-center">
          <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-300">No messages yet</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        msgs.slice(0, 20).map((m, i) => (
          <View key={i} className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-neutral-50 flex-row items-start gap-2">
            <Text className="flex-1 text-sm text-neutral-700">{m.content}</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-300 shrink-0">{m.created_at?.slice(11, 19)}</Text>
          </View>
        ))
      )}
    </View>
  )
}

longitude = request.input('longitude')
notes = request.input('notes')

setting = await DtrSetting.where('key', 'geofencing_enabled').first()
geofencing_enabled = setting is not None and setting.value == 'true'
within_geofence = True

if geofencing_enabled and latitude is not None and longitude is not None:
    office_latitude_setting = await DtrSetting.where('key', 'office_latitude').first()
    office_longitude_setting = await DtrSetting.where('key', 'office_longitude').first()
    radius_setting = await DtrSetting.where('key', 'geofence_radius_meters').first()
    office_latitude = float(office_latitude_setting.value if office_latitude_setting else 0)
    office_longitude = float(office_longitude_setting.value if office_longitude_setting else 0)
    radius = float(radius_setting.value if radius_setting else 0)

    lon1 = math.radians(office_longitude)

    lon2 = math.radians(float(longitude))

/* @arkzen:endpoint:py:summary
*/
active_orders = await JobOrder.where('status', 'active').get()
inactive_count = await JobOrder.where('status', 'inactive').count()

def _number(value):
    return float(value or 0)

total_cash = sum(1 for order in active_orders if order.disbursement_type == 'CASH')
total_atm = sum(1 for order in active_orders if order.disbursement_type == 'ATM')
total_basic_pay = sum(_number(order.basic_pay) for order in active_orders)
total_sss = sum(_number(order.sss_amount) for order in active_orders)
total_hdmf_premium = sum(_number(order.hdmf_premium) for order in active_orders)
total_hdmf_mpl = sum(_number(order.hdmf_mpl) for order in active_orders)
total_calamity_loan = sum(_number(order.calamity_loan) for order in active_orders)
total_deductions = total_sss + total_hdmf_premium + total_hdmf_mpl + total_calamity_loan
funding_breakdown = {}
group_breakdown = {}
for order in active_orders:
    funding = '' if order.funding is None else str(order.funding)
    group = '' if order.jor_pyrl_group is None else str(order.jor_pyrl_group)
    funding_breakdown.setdefault(funding, {'count': 0, 'total_pay': 0})
    funding_breakdown[funding]['count'] += 1
    funding_breakdown[funding]['total_pay'] += _number(order.basic_pay)
    group_breakdown[group] = group_breakdown.get(group, 0) + 1

return response.json({
    'total_active': len(active_orders),
    'total_inactive': inactive_count,
    'total_atm': total_atm,
    'total_cash': total_cash,
    'total_basic_pay': total_basic_pay,
    'total_sss': total_sss,
    'total_hdmf_premium': total_hdmf_premium,
    'total_hdmf_mpl': total_hdmf_mpl,
    'total_calamity_loan': total_calamity_loan,
    'total_deductions': total_deductions,
    'net_pay': total_basic_pay - total_deductions,
    'funding_breakdown': funding_breakdown,
    'group_breakdown': group_breakdown,
})

const ProgressScreen = () => {
  const { data, loading, error, reload } = useApi<any>('/progress')
  if (loading && !data) return <Screen title="Progress"><Skel n={3} h={130} /></Screen>
  if (error || !data) return <Screen title="Progress"><Empty icon="wifi-off" title="Could not load progress" text={error ?? ''}><Btn kind="primary" label="Retry" onPress={reload} /></Empty></Screen>
  const p: KProfile = data.profile
  const s = data.stats
  const series: { date: string; count: number }[] = data.series
  const max = Math.max(1, ...series.map(x => x.count))
  const activeDays = series.filter(x => x.count > 0).length
  const badges = [
    ['pen-line', 'First post', s.posts >= 1], ['flame', '7-day streak', p.best_streak >= 7], ['brain', '25 words', s.cards >= 25], ['graduation-cap', '3 lessons', s.lessons >= 3],
    ['handshake', 'First correction', s.corrections_given >= 1], ['message-circle', '50 messages', s.messages_sent >= 50], ['medal', 'Word master', s.mastered >= 10], ['star', 'Level 5', data.level >= 5],
  ] as [string, string, boolean][]
  const tiles = [['Words written', s.words_written, 'pen-line'], ['Messages sent', s.messages_sent, 'message-circle'], ['Posts', s.posts, 'file-text'], ['Lessons done', s.lessons, 'graduation-cap'], ['Words in deck', s.cards, 'layers'], ['Mastered', s.mastered, 'medal'], ['Corrections given', s.corrections_given, 'handshake'], ['Corrections received', s.corrections_received, 'pencil']]
  return (
    <Screen title="Progress" subtitle="What you produce matters more than what you tap." onRefresh={reload} refreshing={loading}>
      <Card style={{ gap: 10 }}>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}><View><Text style={{ color: TH.sub, fontWeight: '600' }}>LEVEL</Text><Text style={{ fontSize: 44, fontWeight: '800', color: TH.text }}>{data.level}</Text></View><Text style={{ color: TH.sub }}>{p.xp} XP · {100 - data.level_progress} to next</Text></View>
        <Bar value={data.level_progress} max={100} color={TH.purple} />
      </Card>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 12 }}>
        <Card style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center' }}><Ico n="flame" size={32} /><Text style={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: '800', color: TH.text }}>{p.streak}</Text><Text style={{ color: TH.sub, fontSize: 12 }}>streak · best {p.best_streak}</Text></Card>
        <Card style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center' }}><Ico n="calendar" size={32} /><Text style={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: '800', color: TH.text }}>{activeDays}/14</Text><Text style={{ color: TH.sub, fontSize: 12 }}>active days</Text></Card>
      </View>
      <Card style={{ gap: 10 }}>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: '700', color: TH.text }}>Last 14 days</Text>
        <View accessibilityLabel="Activity over the last 14 days" style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 4, height: 110 }}>{series.map(d => <View key={d.date} style={{ flex: 1, height: `${Math.max(4, (d.count / max) * 100)}%`, borderRadius: 5, backgroundColor: TH.blue, opacity: d.count ? 1 : 0.18 }} />)}</View>
      </Card>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>{tiles.map(t => <Card key={t[0] as string} style={{ width: '47.5%', padding: 14 }}><Ico n={t[2] as string} size={20} /><Text style={{ fontSize: 26, fontWeight: '800', color: TH.text }}>{t[1]}</Text><Text style={{ color: TH.sub, fontSize: 13 }}>{t[0]}</Text></Card>)}</View>
      {s.corrections_received > 0 && <Card style={{ gap: 8 }}><View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}><Text style={{ fontWeight: '700', color: TH.text }}>Corrections you accepted</Text><Text style={{ color: TH.sub }}>{s.corrections_accepted}/{s.corrections_received}</Text></View><Bar value={s.corrections_accepted} max={s.corrections_received} color={TH.green} /></Card>}
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: '700', color: TH.text }}>Milestones</Text>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>{badges.map(b => <Card key={b[1]} style={{ width: '47.5%', alignItems: 'center', padding: 14, opacity: b[2] ? 1 : 0.4 }}><Ico n={b[0]} size={28} /><Text style={{ fontWeight: '600', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4, color: TH.text }}>{b[1]}</Text></Card>)}</View>
    </Screen>
  )
}

const IndexLynxPage = ({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate: (page: string) => void }) => (
  <scroll-view className="flex-1 p-4 gap-y-3 pb-10">
    <text className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900">Layout Test</text>
    <text className="text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
      This test demonstrates nested layout chains in the arkzen native framework. 
      Each screen declares a layout, which can chain to parent layouts or apply guards.
    </text>
    <view style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      <view
        bindtap={() => onNavigate('single')}
        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-indigo-600 rounded-lg"
      >
        <text className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Single Layout</text>
        <text className="text-xs text-indigo-100">No chain, uses: AppShellLayout</text>
      </view>

      <view
        bindtap={() => onNavigate('chain')}
        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-indigo-600 rounded-lg"
      >
        <text className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Layout Chain</text>
        <text className="text-xs text-indigo-100">Chain: AppShellLayout → TabPanelLayout</text>
      </view>

      <view
        bindtap={() => onNavigate('guard-only')}
        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-indigo-600 rounded-lg"
      >
        <text className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Guard Only (+auth)</text>
        <text className="text-xs text-indigo-100">Uses AuthLayout guard, no custom layout</text>
      </view>

      <view
        bindtap={() => onNavigate('guard-chain')}
        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-indigo-600 rounded-lg"
      >
        <text className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Guard + Chain (+auth:tab-panel)</text>
        <text className="text-xs text-indigo-100">Chain: AppShellLayout → TabPanelLayout → AuthLayout</text>
      </view>

      <view
        bindtap={() => onNavigate('native-parity')}
        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-indigo-600 rounded-lg"
      >
        <text className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Native Parity Test</text>
        <text className="text-xs text-indigo-100">Demonstrates native + web layout equivalence</text>
      </view>

      {/* Guide Reference */}
      <view className="mt-8" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
        <text className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">Guide Reference</text>
        {[
          { label: 'Single layout (no chain)', combo: 'layout: app-shell', tag: '@arkzen:native:layout:app-shell' },
          { label: 'Layout chaining', combo: 'layout: tab-panel (with parent: app-shell)', tag: '@arkzen:native:layout:tab-panel' },
          { label: 'Guard only', combo: 'layout: +auth', tag: 'Guard: AuthLayout' },
          { label: 'Guard + chain', combo: 'layout: +auth:tab-panel', tag: 'Chain: auth → app-shell' },
        ].map(({ label, combo, tag }) => (
          <view key={label} className="border border-indigo-300 border-opacity-40 rounded-lg p-3.5 flex-row items-center" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
            <view className="flex-1">
              <text className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">{label}</text>
              <text className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{combo}</text>
            </view>
            <view className="bg-indigo-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
              <text className="text-xs text-indigo-700 font-bold font-mono">{tag}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        ))}
      </view>
    </view>
  </scroll-view>
)

const DashboardScreen = () => {

    await logout()
    replace('login')
  }

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-[#eef2f0]">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-200 bg-white px-5 py-4">
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
          <BrandMark size={32} />
          <View>
            <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-neutral-900">{user?.name ?? 'Signed in'}</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-500">{user?.email}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleLogout} accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel="Sign out" className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
          <LogOut size={15} color="#525252" />
          <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-600">Sign out</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 32 }} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <View className="mx-4 mt-4 flex-row items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-5">

            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-900">The token reached the store</Text>
            <Text className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-emerald-900">
              This screen sits behind the auth guard. A provider sign-in comes back through the deep link,
              the store saves the token, and fetchMe loads this profile.
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <ProviderStatus />

        <View className="mx-4 mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-200 bg-white p-5">
          <View className="mb-3 flex-row items-center gap-2">
            <KeyRound size={16} color="#171717" />
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900">Session user</Text>
          </View>
          <View className="rounded-xl bg-neutral-50 p-4">
            <Text className="font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-neutral-700">{JSON.stringify(user, null, 2)}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  )
}

  const { user, logout } = useAuthStore()

  return (
    <view className="flex-1 bg-[#eef2f0]">
      <view className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-200 bg-white px-5 py-4">
        <view className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
          <view className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#1f3a34]">
            <Icon set="lucide" name="key-round" size={16} color="#f4c95d" />
          </view>
          <view>
            <text className="text-base font-semibold text-neutral-900">{user?.name ?? 'Signed in'}</text>
            <text className="text-xs text-neutral-500">{user?.email}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5" bindtap={() => logout()}>
          <Icon set="lucide" name="log-out" size={15} color="#525252" />
          <text className="text-xs text-neutral-600">Sign out</text>
        </view>
      </view>

          <Icon set="lucide" name="shield-check" size={22} color="#047857" />
          <view className="flex-1">
            <text className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-900">The token reached the store</text>
            <text className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-emerald-900">
              This screen sits behind the auth guard. The link you pasted carried the token, the store saved it, and fetchMe loaded this profile.
            </text>
          </view>
        </view>

        <LynxProviderStatus />

        <view className="mx-4 mb-8 mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-200 bg-white p-5">
          <text className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900">Session user</text>
          <view className="rounded-xl bg-neutral-50 p-4">
            <text className="font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-neutral-700">{JSON.stringify(user, null, 2)}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </scroll-view>
    </view>
  )
}

/* @arkzen:native:page:layout:guest */

import { useState } from '@lynx-js/react'

const IndexLynxPage = () => {
  const [name,      setName]      = useState('')
  const [email,     setEmail]     = useState('')
  const [message,   setMessage]   = useState('')
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!name || !email || !message) return
    setSubmitted(true)
    setName(''); setEmail(''); setMessage('')
    setTimeout(() => setSubmitted(false), 3000)
  }

  return (
    <scroll-view className="flex-1 bg-neutral-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <view className="bg-white border-b border-neutral-200">
        <view className="px-6 py-4 flex-row items-center" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
          <text className="text-2xl">💻</text>
          <text className="font-semibold text-neutral-900">Portfolio</text>
        </view>
      </view>

      <view className="px-6 py-16" style={{ gap: 80 }}>
        {/* Hero */}
        <view className="items-center">
          <text className="text-5xl font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-4 text-center">Full-Stack Developer</text>
          <text className="text-lg text-neutral-600">Crafting digital experiences</text>
        </view>

        {/* Projects */}
        <view>
          <view className="flex-row items-center mb-8" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            <text className="text-2xl font-semibold text-neutral-900">⭐ Projects</text>
          </view>
          <view className="flex-row flex-wrap" style={{ gap: 24 }}>
            {PROJECTS.map(p => (
              <view key={p.id} className="flex-1 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-neutral-200" style={{ overflow: 'hidden', minWidth: '30%' }}>
                <view className="h-32 bg-neutral-100 items-center justify-center">
                  <text className="text-5xl">{p.image}</text>
                </view>
                <view className="p-6">
                  <text className="text-lg font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-2">{p.title}</text>
                  <text className="text-sm text-neutral-600 mb-4">{p.description}</text>
                  <view className="flex-row flex-wrap mb-4" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                    {p.tags.map((t, i) => (
                      <text key={i} className="px-2 py-1 text-xs bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-600 rounded">{t}</text>
                    ))}
                  </view>
                  <text className="text-sm text-neutral-900 font-medium" bindtap={() => openURL(p.url)}>View ↗</text>
                </view>
              </view>
            ))}
          </view>
        </view>

        {/* Skills */}
        <view>
          <text className="text-2xl font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-12">Skills</text>
          <view className="flex-row flex-wrap" style={{ gap: 48 }}>
            {CATEGORIES.map(cat => (
              <view key={cat} className="flex-1" style={{ minWidth: '45%' }}>
                <text className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-6" style={{ letterSpacing: 1.5, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{cat}</text>
                <view style={{ gap: 16 }}>
                  {SKILLS.filter(s => s.category === cat).map((s, i) => (
                    <view key={i}>
                      <view className="flex-row justify-between mb-2">
                        <text className="text-sm text-neutral-700">{s.name}</text>
                        <text className="text-xs text-neutral-500">{s.proficiency}%</text>
                      </view>
                      <view className="h-2 bg-neutral-200 rounded-full">
                        <view className="h-full bg-neutral-900 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${s.proficiency}%` }} />
                      </view>
                    </view>
                  ))}
                </view>
              </view>
            ))}
          </view>
        </view>

        {/* Contact */}
        <view className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-neutral-200 p-8">
          <view className="flex-row items-center mb-6" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            <text className="text-2xl">✉️</text>
            <text className="text-2xl font-semibold text-neutral-900">Contact</text>
          </view>
          {submitted && (
            <view className="mb-6 p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg">
              <text className="text-emerald-600 text-sm">Thanks! Message sent.</text>
            </view>
          )}
          <view style={{ gap: 16 }}>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Name"
              bindinput={(e) => setName(e.detail.value)}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 text-sm border border-neutral-200 rounded-lg"
            />
            <input
              type="email"
              placeholder="Email"
              bindinput={(e) => setEmail(e.detail.value)}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 text-sm border border-neutral-200 rounded-lg"
            />
            <textarea
              placeholder="Message"
              maxlines={4}
              bindinput={(e) => setMessage(e.detail.value)}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 text-sm border border-neutral-200 rounded-lg"
            />
            <view
              bindtap={handleSend}
              className="w-full bg-neutral-900 rounded-lg py-2 items-center"
            >
              <text className="text-white text-sm font-medium">Send</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </scroll-view>
  )
}

const formatSize = (bytes: number) => {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`
  if (bytes < 1048576) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
  return `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`
}

const FileMime = ({ mime }: { mime: string }) => {
  const label = mime.startsWith('image/') ? '🖼️'
    : mime.includes('pdf')               ? '📄'
    : mime.includes('video')             ? '🎬'
    : mime.includes('zip') || mime.includes('rar') ? '🗜️'
    : '📁'
  return <Text className="text-xl">{label}</Text>
}
